title: Rust size-rotating log writer
context: Size-based log writer. When writing a line (including its newline) would push the current file past max_bytes, it rotates: app.log becomes app.log.1, app.log.1 becomes app.log.2, and so on, keeping `keep` old files and deleting the oldest. The writer may be reopened on an existing log file. Each line must be on disk when write_line returns, and I/O errors must be returned, never panic.
